description: The Sensor_DI block processes channel-specific signal functions cyclically for a digital input value from S7-300/400 SM digital input modules in a cement plant application.

inputs.name: VALUE
inputs.description: the digital input value from the process image

inputs.name: VALUE_QC
inputs.description: the value status of the digital input channel

inputs.name: PQC
inputs.description: enables the use of the value status in the process image if set to TRUE

inputs.name: SIM_ON
inputs.description: activates simulation mode if set to TRUE

inputs.name: SUBS_ON
inputs.description: enables substitution mode if set to TRUE

inputs.name: LAST_ON
inputs.description: enables the hold last value function if set to TRUE

outputs.name: QBAD
outputs.description: indicates an invalid process value if set to TRUE

outputs.name: QLAST
outputs.description: indicates that the last valid value is being output if set to TRUE

outputs.name: QMOD_ERR
outputs.description: indicates a higher-level error if set to TRUE

outputs.name: QSIM
outputs.description: indicates simulation mode if set to TRUE

outputs.name: QSUBS
outputs.description: indicates substitution mode if set to TRUE

outputs.name: QUALITY
outputs.description: the quality code of the output value
